includes: Guidance in making your own custom, hand-pressed button keepsake..
Receive either two photo strips or one 4x6 print, all digital photos, and a handmade souvenir
Make your Own Souvenir and Photo Booth Session
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller

blurb: Fun 20–30 minute hosted photo booth session at the Halifax Cruise Port studio location! Pose with Nova Scotia props, choose from a selection of Nova Scotia backgrounds and slogans. Select your favourite pose and make your own souvenir button pin, fridge magnet or keychain. We'll show you how! Take home printed photos plus all your digital pictures for immediate sharing. Your Nova Scotia story starts here, at Portside Photobooth, Halifax.
